The project develops its tools in the open. Each one is listed below with its
current status: **live** and usable, **in development**, or **planned** for a
later phase. Cards link through to the repository or the running application.

::: {#actame-tools}
:::

## Using and citing the tools

All ACTAME tools are released under open licences and can be run locally or
reached through the links above. Each repository carries its own installation
instructions, and layers used in the tools are credited to their sources in the
Atlas and Metadata components.

If you use a tool or its underlying layers in your own work, please cite the
project — see [Outputs](publications.qmd) for the current citation.

::: {.status-note}
**Adding a tool.** This page is generated from `tools.yml` in the site
repository. Adding a new tool means adding one entry to that file — title,
short description, link, status tags and an optional thumbnail in `assets/` —
and committing. The card appears on the next build; nothing else needs to
change.
:::
